transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... well, I guess I came in because I just can't seem to shake this feeling. It's... it's just really heavy. Hopeless, I suppose. It kind of feels like everything I tried to build after my divorce has just... collapsed. And I'm just sitting under it all.
Have you been feeling this way most days, and is it different from how you usually feel?
Yeah... most days. It's, um, definitely not my normal. It's just been hanging over me for... about a month, I guess. Ever since the... the financial mess from the divorce really hit.
Have you experienced these feelings every day for most of the day?
Yeah... I mean, yes. Pretty much all day. Like I said, it's just... I can't shake it. I just feel like I'm sitting under it all the time, and it doesn't really lift.
Have you lost interest or felt less pleasure in things you used to enjoy?
Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't... I haven't really thought about it. I guess I just do what I need to do.
Have you found that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you once liked?
I... I don't know. I just... I don't really do much anymore. I haven't really paid attention to whether I like it or not.
Have you found that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you once liked?

I thought I just... I mean, like I said, I'm really not sure. I just go to work and come home. I haven't been paying attention to whether I'm having fun or not. It's just... not something I think about right now.
Have you noticed any change in how you feel about things you used to enjoy, even small things like hobbies, watching TV, or spending time with friends?
I... I don't really have hobbies. And I haven't seen friends in a while. TV is just... I mean, it's just on in the background. I don't really know if my feelings about it changed. It's just there.
Have you noticed that things you used to enjoy, even small things, don’t seem to bring you any pleasure anymore?
I... look, I don't know what else to say about this. I'm just... I'm not doing much. I don't feel much of anything about it. It's just how it is.
Looking back, do you notice that things you used to enjoy, even small things like hobbies, watching TV, or spending time with friends, don’t seem to bring you any pleasure anymore?
I... I feel like you keep asking me the same thing. I really don't have a different answer for you. I just... I don't feel much. That's all.
Have you been feeling tired or having little energy lately, even after resting?

Yeah. I guess... it's just really hard to get going. Getting through a normal workday feels like... dragging wet concrete. I don't know. Even just taking a shower or opening my laptop... it just takes more energy than I seem to have.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?
I don't think so. I haven't really been paying attention to that.
Have you been feeling like you're not worth much or that you're failing at things more than usual?

I don't know... I mean, I guess so. I just... I keep thinking about how bad I am at my job. Like I'm a terrible engineer. And a failed wife. I just feel like a burden to everyone. I keep... replaying things in my head. Like every missed calculation at work, or some tense email I sent... it just feels like proof that I ruin everything.
Have you had any thoughts about not wanting to live anymore or if the world would be better off without you?

Yeah... I guess I have. It's just... I've been thinking that it would be easier if I just didn't wake up. It got... a bit intense the other night. I scared myself. I ended up calling the employee assistance program.
Have you ever had a period of time before this one where you felt down or hopeless for at least two weeks in a row?
I don't think so. Um... not that I remember, anyway.
